source.paper: Koshizuka, S. & Oka, Y. (1996). Moving-particle semi-implicit method for fragmentation of incompressible fluid. Nuclear Science and Engineering, 123(3), 421-434.
source.note: The reference pressure peak is read from Fig. 15 of the original paper. The probe is located at x = 0.584 m (right wall), y = 0.024 m from the floor.

notes: The reference value is from the MPS method (Koshizuka & Oka 1996).
WCSPH typically overpredicts pressure peaks at coarse resolution due to compressibility effects.
The pressure peak converges with resolution refinement but may not reach the MPS value exactly.
The 12% tolerance is per the task specification.
